transcription: I should have never effed my toaster. Part two, I'm finally able to break out of my shell a little bit and we actually start hitting it off. She's also a nerd and had a lot of cool personal projects of her own, and seemed really interested by mine as well. No, I did not tell her about the effing toaster. The date goes so well that she ends up at my apartment. In hindsight, this should not have happened but in the moment I was not thinking about the toaster at all. I wake up the next morning to the smell of burning rubber and the smell of chlorine. Without hesitation I spring up and rush to the kitchen to find her wearing only my shirt trying to pry out a piece of burnt toast covered in my kids for my toaster. Sorry Anon, I was trying to surprise you with breakfast in bed but I think your toaster is broken. My soul leaves my body and I'm pale as a horse. She doesn't seem to have noticed my toaster was a homemade flush light. I gently push her to the side and set the toaster down behind me. I said, yeah that thing never worked well, I tried fixing it and I think it just made it worse. If only she knew my quote, fixing, was banging the hell out of it every day. She hands me a plate of burnt eggs and tells me we'll buy another one after breakfast and another round of fun. I still have no idea how she didn't smell the god awful scent of burnt man mayo orange and that was in the toaster, I was extremely lucky for that. She's already planned a second date next week. But the new toaster she got me has two slits now and looks much tighter.
